definitions.name: F2B.AMOUNTS
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Vector of amounts

definitions.name: F2B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> key with the largest value, first key on ties

definitions.name: F2B.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE F2B.NAMES LE F2B.AMOUNTS G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: ledger entries -> Record name to sum of amounts

definitions.name: F2B.WHERE
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: vector mask -> the elements of vector whose mask lane is TRUE, in order

definitions.name: F2B.JOINSP
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: F2B.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER 'CW' BIND CW CHARS 0 GET UPPER CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: F2B.DIVCOUNT
definitions.body: 'CN' BIND 1 0 CN 1 CN RANGE G0A.MOD 1 LT SELECT G0A.SUM
definitions.note: positive integer -> number of its positive divisors

definitions.name: F2B.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE 'PC' BIND PC PC [ F2B.DIVCOUNT 2 EQ ] MAP F2B.WHERE
definitions.note: n -> Vector of primes <= n ascending ([ ] if none)

definitions.name: F2B.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE 'DC' BIND DC DN DC G0A.MOD 1 LT F2B.WHERE
definitions.note: n -> Vector of positive divisors ascending

definitions.name: F2B.BINARY
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND 2 5 0 RANGE POW 'BP' BIND BN BP DIV FLOOR 'BQ' BIND BQ 2 G0A.MOD BQ 0 GT F2B.WHERE STR JOIN
definitions.note: n in 1..63 -> base 2 String without leading zeros

definitions.name: F2B.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'CN' BIND 1 150 RANGE CN [ 'IG' BIND 'CV' BIND 1 CV 2 DIV CV 3 MUL 1 ADD CV 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT CV 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN 'CS' BIND 1 0 CS 1 GT SELECT G0A.SUM 1 0 CN 1 GT SELECT ADD
definitions.note: n -> Collatz steps to reach 1 (valid while steps <= 150)

definitions.name: F2B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'ML' BIND MS ML 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS ML 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: F2B.MAD
definitions.body: 'XS' BIND XS XS F2B.MEDIAN SUB F2B.ABS F2B.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: F2B.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'XS' BIND XS SORT 'SS' BIND SS 0 GET 'LO' BIND SS -1 GET 'HI' BIND XS LO SUB HI LO SUB DIV

definitions.name: F2B.LINE
definitions.body: 'OD' BIND OD 'price' GET 'OP' BIND 0 OP OP NIL? SELECT OD 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price, 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: F2B.TAGS
definitions.body: 'TG' BIND TG 'tags' GET 'TT' BIND [ ] TT 2 COLLECT 0 1 TT NIL? SELECT GET UNIQUE
definitions.note: order Record -> its distinct tags as a Vector ([ ] when none)

definitions.name: F2B.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders JSON text -> Record sku to sum of qty
